title: China’s Tmall Face Cream Market Contracts as Repair-Focused Skincare Gains Momentum
summary: China’s face cream market on Tmall contracted sharply in October 2026, with sales volumes dropping by more than half from a year earlier.Despite the overall market slowdown, consumer demand continued to gravitate toward products targeting skin repair, barrier support, sensitivity care, and anti-agin
